name: Naevys
source:
Naevys is a blunt and sharp-tongued elf. From what you've gathered, she has worked for the Keeper for a very long time. 

Other than being a librarian, she takes care of all the administrative tasks for the mansion. She probably has something sweet buried very deep inside her, but it will never come out.

[In game description]
